title: A*-Thought: Efficient Reasoning via Bidirectional Compression for Low-Resource Settings
authors_zh: Xiaoang Xu、Shuo Wang、Xu Han、Zhenghao Liu、Huijia Wu、Peipei Li、Zhiyuan Liu、Maosong Sun、Zhaofeng He
paper_type_zh: 推理轨迹压缩数据集与搜索构造方法
best_for_zh: 关注长链推理压缩、SFT 数据和验证器边界的读者
one_line: A*-Thought compresses s1K-1.1 long-CoT traces with BIS-guided A* search and s1.1-32B validation, releasing a one-thousand-record SFT dataset and model checkpoints.
A*-Thought 使用 BIS 引导的 A* 搜索与 s1.1-32B 验证，将 s1K-1.1 长链推理压缩为一千条 SFT 轨迹。
why: It makes reasoning-token reduction a reusable trace-construction problem while preserving model-based path validation and upstream provenance as audit boundaries.
inclusion_reason: Releases a search-and-validator recipe and one-thousand-record compressed long-CoT dataset for SFT reasoning-token reduction.

title: Problem
问题
html: Long chain-of-thought can improve reasoning accuracy, but it also raises inference latency, memory use, and deployment cost. Simply prompting a model to be brief, truncating its output, or deleting locally redundant tokens can remove steps that are necessary for reaching the answer. A*-Thought therefore treats efficient reasoning as a trace-construction problem: given an existing long reasoning trajectory and its target solution, select a shorter sequence of informative spans that can still supervise a model under restricted output budgets.
长链推理可能提高正确率，但也会增加推理延迟、内存占用和部署成本。仅要求模型简短作答、直接截断输出，或删除局部看似冗余的 token，都可能移除通向答案所必需的步骤。因此，A*-Thought 将高效推理视为轨迹构造问题：给定一条已有长推理轨迹及其目标解，选择更短且信息密度更高的推理 span，使其仍能在受限输出预算下监督模型。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: A-Thought combines step-level ranking with path-level search. A bidirectional importance score ranks each thought step by its relationship to both the question and the known solution. An A procedure then assembles high-ranked steps and their local neighbors into candidate paths, using s1.1-32B to judge current-path quality and a solution-conditioned future-cost estimate to guide expansion. The accepted compressed thought is paired with the original solution to form an SFT example; the public AStar-Thought-1k release contains the resulting compact conversations and search records.

A-Thought 将步骤级排序与路径级搜索结合起来。双向重要性分数同时根据每个思考步骤与问题、已知目标解的关系进行排序；随后，A 搜索把高分步骤及其局部相邻步骤组装成候选路径，并使用 s1.1-32B 判断当前路径质量，再以条件于目标解的未来成本引导扩展。通过选择的压缩 thought 与原 solution 配对，形成 SFT 样本；公开的 AStar-Thought-1k 包含这些紧凑对话及搜索记录。

title: Method
方法
html:
The source object is the 1,000-example s1K-1.1 mathematics set. The official loader reads each question, its long deepseek_thinking_trajectory, and its deepseek_attempt solution, then formats them as a user–assistant conversation with separate thought and solution fields. The upstream trace generator, source mixture, and audit status remain properties of s1K-1.1 rather than newly established facts in A*-Thought.

For step-level scoring, the long thought is segmented at double newlines. A compact GPT-2 scorer estimates a bidirectional importance score from each step’s relationship to the question and to the known solution; alpha balances the two directions. Steps are sorted by this score. A search node contains a span centered on a selected step together with its immediate neighbors, rather than an isolated sentence, to reduce discontinuities caused by compression.

A* search starts from the highest-ranked span and expands candidate paths according to a cost that combines current-path quality with the estimated future cost of reaching the fixed solution. The latter is expressed through the conditional self-information of the solution given the question and current path. Once the search reaches the minimum depth, s1.1-32B checks whether the partial path can lead to the target solution. A passing path terminates the search; if no path passes before the maximum depth, the current path is returned at that limit. The official script defaults to alpha=0.5, beta=0.1, expansion size 2, minimum depth 5, and maximum depth 20.

Construction preserves the original solution and replaces only the thought with the selected spans. Released rows contain system, two-message conversations, compression rate, and search_steps. The compact traces are used for three-epoch full SFT through LLaMA-Factory on QwQ-32B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, and s1.1-32B. The paper evaluates the trained models under 512-, 1024-, 2048-, and 4096-token output budgets; these budgets describe evaluation, not separate dataset splits.

源数据对象是包含 1,000 个数学样本的 s1K-1.1。官方加载器读取每条样本的 question、长 deepseek_thinking_trajectory 和 deepseek_attempt solution，再将其格式化为 thought 与 solution 分区明确的用户—助手对话。上游轨迹生成器、来源混合和审计状态仍属于 s1K-1.1 的属性，A*-Thought 并未重新证明这些事实。

在步骤级评分阶段，长 thought 以双换行切分。小型 GPT-2 scorer 根据每个步骤与问题及已知目标解的关系计算双向重要性分数，alpha 用于平衡两个方向，然后按该分数排序。搜索节点不是孤立句子，而是以一个被选步骤为中心、同时包含其直接前后步骤的 span，以减少压缩造成的语义断裂。

A* 搜索从最高分 span 开始，并依据“当前路径质量 + 到达固定目标解的预计未来成本”扩展候选路径。未来成本由给定问题和当前路径时目标解的条件自信息表示。达到最低搜索深度后，s1.1-32B 判断当前部分路径能否通向目标解；验证通过即终止搜索。若在最大深度前没有路径通过，算法会在达到上限时直接返回当前路径。官方脚本默认使用 alpha=0.5、beta=0.1、扩展大小 2、最低深度 5 和最大深度 20。

构造过程保留原 solution，只用选中的 span 替换 thought。公开数据行包含 system、两轮 conversations、压缩 rate 和 search_steps。这些紧凑轨迹通过 LLaMA-Factory 对 QwQ-32B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 和 s1.1-32B 进行三轮 full SFT。论文在 512、1024、2048 和 4096 token 输出预算下评测训练后的模型；这些预算属于评测设置，并非不同数据切分。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
For QwQ-32B at a 512-token budget, the paper reports that direct s1K-1.1 SFT reaches 12.3 average accuracy and 2.41 ACU across MATH500, AMC23, OlympiadBench, and GSM8K, while A-Thought SFT reaches 29.4 accuracy and 5.99 ACU. At a 4096-token budget, A-Thought reduces average response length from 2826.00 to 1876.66 tokens relative to direct s1K-1.1 SFT, while average accuracy changes from 70.6 to 69.3. It also reports that compressed training data contains 31.31% of the original token volume and reduces training time by approximately 21.58%–24.25% across the three backbones.

Ablations and evaluations on multiple backbones support the claim that BIS-guided A* selection can improve the accuracy–length trade-off compared with the tested prompting and compression baselines. They do not establish that every retained span is logically necessary, that every validator judgment is correct, or that the upstream s1K-1.1 records are uncontaminated. The official GitHub repository, 1K-row dataset, and three trained checkpoints make the construction output inspectable, but benchmark performance is not a substitute for trace-level quality or provenance auditing.

在 512-token 预算下，论文报告 QwQ-32B 直接使用 s1K-1.1 SFT 后，在 MATH500、AMC23、OlympiadBench 和 GSM8K 上的平均正确率为 12.3、ACU 为 2.41；使用 A-Thought SFT 后，平均正确率为 29.4、ACU 为 5.99。在 4096-token 预算下，相比直接使用 s1K-1.1 SFT，A-Thought 将平均响应长度从 2826.00 降至 1876.66 token，同时平均正确率从 70.6 变为 69.3。论文还报告压缩训练数据的 token 量为原数据的 31.31%，三个 backbone 的训练时间约下降 21.58%–24.25%。

消融实验和多 backbone 结果支持 BIS 引导的 A* 选择能够改善相对于所测提示与压缩基线的正确率—长度权衡，但不能证明每个保留 span 都在逻辑上必要、每个验证判断都正确，也不能证明上游 s1K-1.1 不含污染。官方 GitHub、1K 行数据集和三个训练后 checkpoint 使构造输出可检查，但基准表现不能替代轨迹级质量和来源审计。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The main contribution is a solution-aware, span-level construction procedure rather than another instruction to “think less.” BIS uses both the question and target solution to identify candidate steps, while A* evaluates combinations of locally coherent spans instead of pruning each token or sentence independently. The search explicitly separates present-path quality from estimated remaining cost and records the selected path as reusable SFT data. This differs from prompt-only brevity methods and from fixed-rate compression because the retained amount is determined by a validator-guided search trajectory rather than a uniform deletion budget.

其主要贡献是一个利用目标解信息的 span 级数据构造过程，而不是又一种“少想一点”的提示。BIS 同时利用问题和目标解识别候选步骤，A* 则搜索由局部连贯 span 组成的组合，而非独立裁剪每个 token 或句子。搜索明确区分当前路径质量与预计剩余成本，并将所选路径记录为可复用的 SFT 数据。它与仅靠提示控制简洁度的方法及固定比例压缩不同：最终保留多少内容由验证器引导的搜索轨迹决定，而不是统一删除预算。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Construction requires an existing long CoT and its target solution. Because BIS and the future-cost term condition on that solution, the method is an offline distillation recipe rather than a directly deployable search procedure for an unseen question whose answer is unknown. It also inherits the source composition, trace-generation choices, possible contamination, and rights of s1K-1.1; the AStar-Thought release does not provide an independent provenance or decontamination audit.

The s1.1-32B validator is a model-based selector, not a formal proof checker. It can accept a path that appears capable of reaching the supplied solution despite a hidden logical gap, or reject an alternative but valid path. Moreover, reaching the maximum depth causes the current path to be returned even without validator acceptance. Selecting and reordering spans may remove dependencies or introduce discontinuities, although neighboring steps are included to reduce this risk.

The released dataset has only about 1,000 mathematics records and one visible training split; a complete rejection manifest, validator confidence calibration, per-item source lineage, and release license are not established in the checked artifacts. Data construction itself requires GPT-2 scoring and repeated s1.1-32B validation, so “low-resource” primarily describes the trained model’s inference regime rather than cost-free dataset construction. The paper studies SFT only; RL use remains future work.

构造过程要求预先存在长 CoT 和目标解。由于 BIS 和未来成本项都以该解为条件，该方法属于离线蒸馏配方，而不是能够直接用于答案未知的新问题的在线搜索程序。它还继承 s1K-1.1 的来源构成、轨迹生成选择、潜在污染和权利边界；AStar-Thought 发布没有提供独立的来源或去污染审计。

s1.1-32B 验证器是模型式选择器，不是形式化证明检查器。它可能接受一条表面上能通向给定解、但隐藏逻辑缺口的路径，也可能拒绝另一条有效路径。此外，达到最大搜索深度时，即使没有通过验证，当前路径仍会被返回。选择和重排 span 可能移除依赖关系或引入不连续，尽管方法通过保留相邻步骤来缓解这一风险。

公开数据集仅包含约 1,000 条数学记录和一个可见训练切分；已核查工件没有建立完整拒绝清单、验证器置信度校准、条目级来源血缘和发布许可证。数据构造本身需要 GPT-2 评分和多次 s1.1-32B 验证，因此“低资源”主要描述训练后模型的推理场景，而非零成本的数据构造。论文目前只研究 SFT，RL 使用仍属于未来工作。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
AStar-Thought-1k is useful for studying long-to-short reasoning distillation as an explicit selection pipeline. Researchers can inspect how step segmentation, solution-aware scoring, neighborhood spans, search depth, expansion width, validator choice, and cost weights change the traces that reach SFT. The public code also provides a baseline for comparing validator-guided path search with fixed compression, prompting, or token-budget methods.

Reuse should preserve the distinction between a compact demonstration and a verified proof. Before training or redistribution, users should pin the dataset and code revisions, audit s1K-1.1 provenance and licensing, check overlap with target evaluations, and sample validator failures. The released search metadata can support such analysis, but it is not itself a complete quality label or rejection log.

AStar-Thought-1k 适合用于研究把长推理蒸馏为短推理的显式选择流水线。研究者可以检查步骤切分、利用目标解的评分、相邻 span、搜索深度、扩展宽度、验证器选择和代价权重如何改变最终进入 SFT 的轨迹。公开代码也提供了一个基线，可用于比较验证器引导的路径搜索与固定压缩、提示控制或 token-budget 方法。

复用时应区分“紧凑示范”和“已验证证明”。训练或再分发前，需要固定数据与代码版本，审计 s1K-1.1 的来源和许可证，检查与目标评测的重叠，并抽样分析验证器失败。公开的搜索元数据可以支持这些工作，但本身并不是完整质量标签或拒绝日志。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §§3.1–3.2 as a data-construction algorithm: the output is a selected trace paired with the original solution.
  • BIS is bidirectional because it uses both the question and the known solution; this also creates solution-conditioned construction and possible leakage if the recipe is misapplied.
  • A node contains a thought and its immediate neighbors, so A*-Thought performs span selection rather than arbitrary token deletion.
  • Separate validator acceptance from mathematical correctness, and note that the maximum-depth fallback may return an unaccepted path.
  • Compare the 31.31% training-token ratio and response-length reductions with accuracy, and audit s1K-1.1 provenance, contamination, license, and the missing rejection manifest before reuse.

• 第 3.1–3.2 节应作为数据构造算法阅读：输出是与原 solution 配对的被选轨迹。
  • BIS 的“双向”来自同时使用问题和已知目标解；若误用该配方，这也会形成以答案为条件的构造和潜在泄漏。
  • 每个节点包含一个 thought 及其直接相邻步骤，因此 A*-Thought 做的是 span 选择，而非任意 token 删除。
  • 验证器接受不等于数学正确，并需注意最大深度回退可能返回未通过验证的路径。
  • 31.31% 的训练 token 比例和响应长度下降必须与正确率共同解读；复用前还应审计 s1K-1.1 的来源、污染、许可证和缺失的拒绝清单。
